title: Console home: the 「构建应用」 button on a deployment without the AI builder leads somewhere that exists (Studio new package) or hides; /_console/ai redirects to the home
body:
## Source

Walked on 2026-10-27 on the published console 18.2.0 against a local HotCRM runtime with no AI agents: the home shows 从模板开始 and 构建应用 in the greeting row; `/_console/ai` redirects to `/_console/home`. On such a deployment 构建应用 cannot start a build.

## Target

1. The home reads the runtime's AI capability (`/api/v1/ai/agents` empty or absent): 构建应用 then opens Studio's new-package flow with the label 在 Studio 中新建, or hides when the user cannot author.
2. `/_console/ai` on such a deployment shows a one-line page (「此部署未启用 AI 助手」) with the Studio link instead of a silent redirect.

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`, the AI route guard in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests with and without agents; screenshot of the home on a runtime without AI.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-27 fifth review: objectstack main `f9867020c6` (Object UI now under `ui/`), HotCRM `1f3f8880` on platform 18.2.0 (the published console at `/_console`, a fresh dev database), the maintainer's browser pane at 955 × 452 (zh-CN), plus cloud staging (the control-plane home and the test1016 tenant's build chat). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed by where the fix lands, verbatim: 「全部立卡，按落点分仓；#25943 让车道正常派发。」</sub>
